## Introduction

This report analyzes physical attributes of three penguin species—Adélie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo—collected at Palmer Station, Antarctica. We examine species-level variations in body mass, bill dimensions, and flipper length using Python.

Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/) collected by Dr. Kristen Gorman and the Palmer Station, Antarctica LTER. Distributed under the [CC0 1.0 Universal License](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

```{python}

#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

import sys 
import pandas as pd 
import seaborn as sns 
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

import sys

import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

# Verify environment execution path

print(f"Executing Python from: {sys.executable}")

# Load and clean dataset

penguins = load_penguins().dropna(subset=["species", "body_mass_g", "bill_length_mm", "flipper_length_mm"])
```

```{python}
#| label: summary-table

summary_df = penguins.groupby("species").agg(
    sample_size=("species", "size"),
    mean_body_mass_g=("body_mass_g", "mean"),
    mean_bill_length_mm=("bill_length_mm", "mean"),
    mean_flipper_length_mm=("flipper_length_mm", "mean")
).round(1).reset_index()

summary_df.columns = [
    "Species", "Sample Size", "Mean Mass (g)", 
    "Mean Bill Length (mm)", "Mean Flipper Length (mm)"
]

summary_df
```

```{python}
#| label: body-mass-boxplot

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
sns.boxplot(
    data=penguins,
    x="species",
    y="body_mass_g",
    hue="species",
    palette="Set2",
    legend=False
)
plt.xlabel("Species")
plt.ylabel("Body Mass (g)")
plt.title("Body Mass Distribution Across Species")
plt.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-flipper-mass
#| fig-cap: "Scatter plot showing the relationship between flipper length and body mass across Antarctic penguin species."

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=penguins,
    x="flipper_length_mm",
    y="body_mass_g",
    hue="species",
    palette="Set2",
    s=60,
    alpha=0.8
)
plt.xlabel("Flipper Length (mm)")
plt.ylabel("Body Mass (g)")
plt.title("Flipper Length vs. Body Mass")
plt.legend(title="Species")
plt.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)
plt.show()
```

## Conclusion

The scatter plot demonstrates a strong positive correlation between flipper length and body mass. Gentoo penguins form a distinct group in the top-right corner, reflecting their distinctly larger physical build compared to the Adélie and Chinstrap species.
